answer_2.quote: Following previous studies, we employ both automatic and human evaluations. Style Transfer Accuracy: ... we employ two metrics, denoted as Acc d and Acc s ... Content Preservation: ... we employ BLEU 1 and BLEU 2 ... BERT Score ...
automatic_metrics: G-BL_d (geometric mean of Acc_d and BLEU)
G-BS_d (geometric mean of Acc_d and BERT Score F1)

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 100 samples from the Chinese test set and generate target texts with LX style and JY style for baselines and proposed SC2. Given the source text and the target style, three Chinese native speakers are assigned the task of scoring for style polarity (Sty), content preservation (Con), and fluency (Flu), using a scale of 1 (very bad) to 3 (very good).
answer_4.guideline: scoring for style polarity (Sty), content preservation (Con), and fluency (Flu) using a scale of 1 to 3
